# Synth v36 migration reference

`synth-serial-v36.bin` and `synth-serial-v36.f32` were generated by the unmodified
318feb86bca2f0f19e52e57681a67256103aa846 engine before this corrective pass.

The patch uses one Init oscillator and two per-voice filters, cutoff 1200 Hz and
2400 Hz, in series to MAIN. Prepare 48000 Hz, 256 frames, stereo; restore patch;
trigger MIDI note 60 at velocity 0.7; render sixteen 256-frame blocks. The raw
little-endian float reference stores L then R for each block (8192 samples).
The engine regression decodes the actual historical binary and compares every
sample to this independent pre-change reference with tolerance 1e-6.
